stories.title: Tuinalogy Bloom's Taxonomy Cognitive Level Tagging Tool
stories.description: Create Python script to analyze all C01-C05 KP learning objectives and tag each with appropriate Bloom's cognitive level (记忆/理解/应用/分析/评价/创造). Generate coverage report showing distribution across levels and identify gaps.
acceptanceCriteria: tuinalogy-services/build/tag-bloom-objectives.py reads all C01-C05 KP files and outputs tuinalogy-services/_analysis/bloom-cognitive-levels.json with tags
Report shows distribution of objectives across 6 Bloom's levels; C01 heavily on 记忆/理解, C04-C05 on 应用/分析/评价
Script flags objectives lacking clear cognitive-level indicator verb (e.g., missing '分析', '评价', '创造')
technicalNotes: Files to create: tuinalogy-services/build/tag-bloom-objectives.py, tuinalogy-services/_analysis/bloom-cognitive-levels.json
Test command: uv run python tuinalogy-services/build/tag-bloom-objectives.py (should tag ≥35 objectives, output JSON with all 6 levels represented)

stories.title: Tuinalogy Metacognitive Reflection Prompt Integration
stories.description: Add end-of-KP reflection questions that encourage spaced retrieval of prior CU concepts, self-assessment of learning, and connection between theory and clinical practice. Questions should scaffold from lower to higher Bloom's levels.
acceptanceCriteria: Each C01-C05 KP concludes with 2-3 reflection prompts structured as: (1) recall prior concept (e.g., '回顾C01的八纲辨证，这个案例属于哪一种模式？'), (2) apply to new context, (3) metacognitive self-check (e.g., '你现在能独立教其他学生这个技能吗？为什么？')
Reflection prompts reference specific prior CUs and techniques by name and code
Each KP ends with [反思检查: 学习自评] table asking learner to rate confidence (不能/部分/能够) for 3-4 key competencies
technicalNotes: Files to modify: tuinalogy-services/C01-C05/KP-*.md (append reflection section before end)
